name: Vertex Potential Bounds Disguise
description: Replaces an independent edge-by-edge constraint with a system of vertex-centric sum equations. Because the equation is defined over a vertex's entire neighborhood rather than a single edge, models cannot simply evaluate the 3 possible pairs of states. They must algebraically deduce that the only way to satisfy the sum across all neighbors, given the domain bounds, is if every neighbor has the opposite state.
